entities.name: PMID:25069814
observations: 2014 Journal of Atherosclerosis and Thrombosis study examined venous occlusion in healthy participants (n=25), inherited thrombophilia (n=19), and symptomatic atherosclerosis (n=15).

entities.name: Venous stasis markers
observations: In the reported venous occlusion test, tissue-type plasminogen activator and plasmin–α2-antiplasmin complexes increased, while prothrombin fragment 1+2 and thrombin–antithrombin complexes did not change across the three cohorts; most samples had no quantifiable free thrombin.
